verdict.rationale: PostHog's self-host docs state it is "open-source and freely available for anyone to host themselves" under an MIT license. The public GitHub repo (github.com/PostHog/posthog) is evidenced directly, including a raw README from its services/mcp directory, and community users reference its README and Dockerfile. Missing for 10: an explicit LICENSE-file citation clarifying whether the MIT terms cover the whole codebase (the docs tie MIT to the Docker Compose deployment) and independent corroboration of the license scope.
